name: practical-javascript
description: Every package the Course 3 assignments need at runtime, hoisted to one manifest. The lab image installs this as /home/coder/package.json and create_assignment_zip.js ships the same file at the root of assignments.zip, so the lab, a learner's own computer, and the grader all resolve the same versions. Node walks up to this node_modules from any assignment folder, which is why per-assignment installs are not needed even for assignments that carry their own package.json. Versions track assignments/autograde-docker/package.json; keep them in step so work that runs in the lab also grades.
